name: pit_viper_green
description: Small green pit viper (Malabar/bamboo type): bright leaf green #5fae3a with a pale belly line, compact coil, triangular head, orange-yellow eye with a vertical pupil, heat-pit dot in front of the eye; head right, resting as if on a branch (no branch). Anchor centre; bbox about x -137..+143, y -56..+56.
